title: Streamline icon-button pending/pause states, gesture cancellation, and theme contrast
creator: Claire Nguyen
description: Problem: Multiple regressions have been observed across products where icon-only buttons exhibit inconsistent pending (loading/paused) visuals, unexpected disabled/soft-disabled behavior, and hit-target drift in dark/high-contrast themes. These regressions were surfaced after token refactors and a runtime change to debounce press-release flows. Users report unclear affordances when an action is queued or cancellable, and keyboard/screen-reader feedback is inconsistent. Goal: Define a single, testable visual and interaction contract for icon-only and icon-led compact buttons covering pending (spinner/placeholder), soft-disabled, and press-hold cancellation flows across themes and reduced-motion settings.
acceptance_criteria: Design specs for icon-only and icon-leading buttons with: normal, pending (queued), paused, soft-disabled, and permanently-disabled states.
Accessible semantics defined: ARIA states (aria-pressed, aria-busy), keyboard focus/skip behavior, and screen-reader phrases for each state.
Themed tokens mapped for light, dark, and high-contrast with contrast ratios documented and validated (WCAG AA for 18px primary controls).
Interaction contract documented: immediate tap, press-and-hold to cancel pending action, and visual feedback timing (delay before spinner, debounce window).
Dev-ready tokens and component props: pendingType (spinner|skeleton), cancellable (true|false), softDisabled (true|false), iconAlignment, reducedMotion variant.
Regression test cases and visual snapshots added to Storybook for three themes and reduced-motion, and unit tests for ARIA attributes and click/cancel behavior.
GitHub PR with implementation (design-approved) merged and feature flagged for staged rollout to runtime-1.19.
implementation_notes: Prefer a deferred spinner: show spinner after 220ms by default to avoid flicker for ephemeral requests.
Soft-disabled should preserve focus outline and cursor but suppress primary action and show a subtle overlay token (alpha overlay 12%).

Press-and-hold cancellation: longpress >= 600ms shows cancel affordance; release before 600ms proceeds with original action. Provide clear microcopy for screen readers (e.g., 'Action queued. Press and hold to cancel').
Token migration: introduce token aliases for compactIconHitbox and iconPendingOverlay to avoid breaking existing consumers; include fallback mapping in tokens v2026.03.
Avoid layout shift: spinner must be token-sized and occupy reserved space; if switching from icon to spinner, use cross-fade and constant content box.
Contrast tuning: for high-contrast theme, increase icon fill delta to meet 4.5:1 against surface for interactive controls; document exceptions for ghost variants.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion: replace spinner cross-fades with instant state change and no motion for reduced-motion users.
Edge-case: if button is part of a split action (primary + overflow), ensure pending overlay z-index is bounded to the button only to avoid covering adjacent controls.
Add telemetry hook points: state transitions (queued->in-flight->completed/canceled) to help detect increased cancel rates post-deploy.
engineering_links: Runtime ticket referencing debounce change: ENG-20118
updates: 2026-01-25: Initial investigation — isolated three distinct regressions: spinner flicker, missing aria-busy, and hitbox offset in dark theme.
2026-02-02: Proto created in Figma showing spinner cross-fade and reserved box approach; engineering flagged potential layout constraints in compact containers.
2026-02-15: UX review with PM and Eng — agreed on 220ms spinner delay and 600ms longpress cancel threshold. Added requirement to preserve focus outline for soft-disabled.
2026-02-28: Design QA pass — contrast adjustments for dark-high-contrast branch validated; created snapshot test plan.
2026-03-05: Eng spike completed — implemented token aliases and added Storybook stories for light/dark/contrast/reduced-motion.
2026-03-10: Accessibility review — screen-reader copy updated; recommended aria-live region for cancellation confirmation.
2026-03-12: Engineering PR opened (WIP). Seeking design review on microcopy and visual timing before merge.

Miguel Ortega (Frontend): 'We hit a tricky CSS stacking context in tab bars. Will add isolation class to button when pending overlay is active.'
Samir Patel (Accessibility): 'aria-busy alone isn't sufficient; provide explicit aria-label updates and consider aria-live for cancellation success.'
Jordan Lee (Product): 'Customer reported cancellations during billing flow — prioritize as P1 for user trust.'
